product_name: Bajaj Life Linked Accident Protection Rider II
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual Pure Risk offering Health Cover and Savings Rider
variants: Accidental Death Benefit with Return of Premium (ROP)
Accidental Total Permanent Disability Benefit with Return of Premium (ROP)
key_benefits: Linked accident-protection rider attachable to a base policy at inception or any policy anniversary
Accidental Death Benefit cover up to 3 times the base-policy Sum Assured
Accidental Total Permanent Disability cover (defined dismemberment list, documented 6 months)
All rider benefits are guaranteed (higher of chosen Sum Assured or 105% of Total Premiums Paid)
Return of Premium option: Total Premiums Paid returned on survival to rider maturity (ROP options only)
Rider premium collected over and above base-policy premium

eligibility.policy_term: Rider Policy Term aligned to the base Policy Term
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Rider Premium Paying Term aligned to base Premium Paying Term (Regular / Limited / Single)
eligibility.note: This is a RIDER — it cannot be bought standalone and must be attached to a base policy; rider term and PPT must align to the base policy. Numeric entry-age / sum-assured limits were not recovered from this parse (illustrative SA INR 20 Lakhs ADB / 10 Lakhs ATPD shown only as example).

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Rider Document; rider premium refunded within 7 days of a valid cancellation request.
key_terms.grace_period: Same as the grace period applicable to the base policy.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not applicable — this is an accident-only rider; death by suicide is an exclusion (no accidental-death benefit for suicide).
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Maturity Benefit (Total Premiums Paid) is available ONLY under the 'with ROP' cover options, payable on survival to the Rider Maturity Date; the non-ROP options have NO maturity benefit.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per prevailing tax laws'; GST applicable over and above rider premium.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a RIDER — every claim must reference that it is attached to and dependent on a base policy; it cannot be sold or held standalone.
Benefits pay out only on ACCIDENTAL death or accidental total permanent disability (defined dismemberment list, within 180 days of the accident) — not on any death or illness.
Accidental Death cover is capped at 3x the base-policy Sum Assured.
Return-of-Premium / maturity benefit applies ONLY to the 'with ROP' options and only on survival with no claim paid; the plain ADB/ATPD options have no maturity benefit.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market it as a standalone or all-cause life/health product — it is an accident-only rider tied to a base policy.
Do NOT imply natural-death or illness cover — only accidental death and accidental total permanent disability are covered (suicide is excluded).
Although the descriptor says 'Linked', do NOT advertise market-linked investment returns or fund value — rider benefits are fixed guaranteed amounts / return of premium, not unit-fund growth.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual Pure Risk offering Health Cover and Savings Rider'
That this is a rider that must be taken with a base policy (rider term/PPT aligned to base policy)
Standard disclaimer to read the rider policy document for full terms, conditions and exclusions

gaps: Numeric entry-age / sum-assured eligibility table not recovered from parse (only illustrative SA values shown).
Despite the 'Linked' descriptor, the rider benefits described are fixed/guaranteed and return-of-premium based; the linked classification is carried from the verbatim descriptor.
